_comment: SYNTHETIC sample of Google's Android Key-Attestation status list, in the
(cross-checked against Google's published Android Key-Attestation docs, 2026-07).
Top level is `entries`: a map from certificate serial number, rendered as
Java BigInteger.toString(16) (lowercase hex, no leading zeros), to a status
`expires` and `comment` are optional. The first two entries are Google's own
documented examples; `1234567890abcdef` is a fixture serial the mobile-attest
tests mint an rcgen leaf for, to prove a listed serial -> Verdict::Mismatch.
This crate does NO network I/O — an operator fetches this JSON out of band
and hands the bytes to GoogleStatusList::from_json (snp/tdx CRL discipline).
NOTE: JSON has no comment syntax; this `_comment` key is ignored by the parser.
